reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: Normalize using a method appropriate to the measurement scale.
checks.reason: No concrete platform-conditional normalization/transformation implementation or calibration-to-choice procedure supplies executable preprocessing.
No selected primary confidence/test procedure or explicit multiplicity implementation is specified. Generic partial pooling, intervals and correction do not determine the numerical inference.
No bounded feature/weight/regularization search or concrete procedure deriving its range and stop before lock.

checks.quote: Do not revise it using cohort 2 and retest in the same cohort.
checks.reason: The ban on reusing cohort 2 is correct, but a changed protocol/program is not explicitly refrozen and assigned a fresh independent confirmation set.
Software versions and manifests are requested, but immutable input hashes, executable environment and exact commands are missing.
No clean-environment reproduction of numerical output tables/figures with tolerance and resource/failure/source-difference logs.
